fullPassage: Just like how other rooms in your home can cause anxiety when filled with too much stuff, the same is true for kids. If the play space houses every single toy that has ever been purchased for them since birth, they may not be able to express their feelings, but they can feel overwhelmed by so much stuff. This reminds us of how women look in their closets packed full of clothes and think, I have nothing to wear. __________ helps everyone see what they have and use what they own. You want your kids to feel inspired and imaginative in the room — not overcome with indecision.
